name: ASP.NET Core
description: A C# ASP.NET Core API with minimal APIs, ProblemDetails errors and a build-time OpenAPI export.

specSections.title: API Contract & Error Codes
specSections.guidance: List every endpoint under /api with its method, route, operation ID (the minimal-API .WithName, which becomes the client method name), request and response DTOs, auth policy and ownership rule, and the status codes it returns. Give the error table: each UPPER_SNAKE errorCode, its HTTP status and when it applies; errors are ProblemDetails with an errorCode extension, and validation errors are 400 ValidationProblem with an errors map. Name the auth scheme (Identity cookies for same-origin, JWT bearer for cross-origin or an external IdP) and the health endpoints /api/health/live and /api/health/ready.

order.reason: Change the contract (backend/openapi/api.json) before regenerating the frontend client from it.

generatedFiles.ciCheck: cd {be} && dotnet build src/<App>.Api && git diff --exit-code openapi/api.json

requiredEnv.description: The platform database URI (postgres://…), converted at startup to ConnectionStrings:Default with NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder when that is empty.
Comma-separated frontend origins the CORS policy allows (cross-origin model only).

checklist.item: Domain rules are pure (no EF, ASP.NET or I/O) and unit-tested by FR ID.
Endpoints are thin, return TypedResults with Results<…> types and DTO records (never entities), and have stable operation IDs via .WithName.
Errors are ProblemDetails carrying the spec's errorCode, with no stack traces outside Development.
Every protected endpoint has an authorisation policy plus an ownership check; CORS is enabled only for the cross-origin model with explicit origins.
Options are validated on start, DATABASE_URL conversion is handled in one place, and no secrets are in appsettings*.json.
Integration tests cover success, 400, 401, 403, 404, each errorCode and 409 for each endpoint.
openapi/api.json matches the endpoints (the CI freshness check passes) and the gate is green.

gate: cd {be} && dotnet build -warnaserror && dotnet test && dotnet format --verify-no-changes
cd {be} && dotnet build src/<App>.Api && git diff --exit-code openapi/api.json
